scenarios.name: Molniya 12-Hour Critical Inclination Orbit
scenarios.description: Critical inclination (63.435 deg) locks argument of perigee precession (domega/dt = 0), ensuring 8+ hour apogee dwell over high-latitude northern hemisphere.

scenarios.name: Standard Geostationary Transfer Orbit (GTO)
scenarios.description: Standard transfer from low Earth parking orbit to geostationary orbit with deep atmospheric penetration at perigee.

scenarios.name: Baseline Circular Low Earth Orbit (LEO)
scenarios.description: Reference low circular orbit demonstrating baseline two-body mechanics and fast J2 nodal regression.
